Title: Verify email/password and Entra ID authentication
Description: As a security engineer, I want both authentication flows verified on prod so that we can confirm the identity service is production-ready for the demo. The work tests email/password login and Microsoft Entra ID on prod, verifies tokens are issued and refreshed, confirms roles are enforced on API endpoints, and checks the gateway blocks unauthorized requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Email/password login works on prod; JWT is issued and valid
Refresh token endpoint renews JWT without re-login
Entra ID OIDC login works; user is created or retrieved from database
Entra ID claims map correctly to application roles
API Gateway enforces role-based access control on all endpoints
Unauthorized requests (missing/invalid token) are rejected with 401/403
Session management and token expiration work as designed
TalkingPoints: I'm going to verify both authentication paths work on prod. I'll test email/password and Entra ID flows, token refresh, and role enforcement. This is going to confirm the identity service is production-ready for the demo.

Tasks.Title: Test email/password login flow
Tasks.Description: Create test user, log in, receive JWT, verify token claims.

Tasks.Title: Test refresh token flow
Tasks.Description: Verify refresh endpoint issues new JWT and old token is invalid.

Tasks.Title: Test Entra ID OIDC flow
Tasks.Description: Log in with Microsoft account, verify claim mapping and role assignment.

Tasks.Title: Test role-based access control on endpoints
Tasks.Description: Verify admin-only endpoints reject non-admin tokens; non-admin endpoints allow viewer roles.

Tests.Title: Email/password login works and JWT is issued with correct claims

Steps.Action: POST /auth/login with valid email and password
Steps.Expected: Response status 200 with JWT in body

Steps.Action: Decode JWT and verify claims include email, roles, exp
Steps.Expected: Claims are correct and token is valid

Tests.Title: Refresh token endpoint renews JWT without re-login

Steps.Action: POST /auth/refresh with valid refresh token from login
Verify old token is invalidated (added to blacklist)
Steps.Expected: Attempting to use old token fails with 401

Tests.Title: Entra ID OIDC login creates or retrieves user with correct role mapping

Steps.Action: Initiate Entra ID login flow and complete OIDC redirect
Steps.Expected: User is authenticated and JWT is issued

Steps.Action: Query User table and verify user record exists with mapped roles
Steps.Expected: Entra ID claims are correctly mapped to app roles

Tests.Title: API Gateway enforces role-based access control on all endpoints

Steps.Action: Call admin-only endpoint (/admin/...) with viewer-role JWT
Call same endpoint with admin-role JWT
